_note: CRSP209 (guardrail G1). `go test -timeout` limits one package binary, not one test, so packages run in tiers. Unit tier (everything not listed): -timeout 10s, packages measured under 3 s with `go test -race` on 4 cores. integration: -timeout 60s, packages that start servers, sockets, SQLite or subprocesses, or measured 3 s to 40 s. slow: packages measured over 40 s that do not fit 60 s with honest headroom; their run uses the smallest safe -timeout (150 s) and they are the remaining G1 breaks until they are sped up. Measured on 20 Nov 2026 (docs/work/CRSP209-report.md). Move a package up a tier only with a new measurement.
